meaning: Buying something extra inside an app you already have, like game coins or a bonus level. You pay without leaving the app.
clues: You never leave the app you are using.
It buys extras, like bonus game levels, game coins, or a way to remove ads.
Many phones can be set to ask for a password first, so a child cannot buy by accident.
Its name has a hyphen and three short parts. It starts with the little word I-N.
assumes: Tap to pay happens at a store checkout
A prepaid card holds money loaded ahead of time

decoys.meaning: Paying by holding your phone, watch, or card near a card reader at checkout.
Using your phone's camera to photograph a paper check. The money goes into your bank account without a trip to the bank.
A card you load with money ahead of time. You can spend only what you loaded.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a game came in a box, and you got the whole thing. No tiny shops hiding inside.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today many games are free, then sell extras inside. Turn on the setting that asks for a password before any purchase.
